title: Synchronous complexes turn probabilities into definite experiences

statements.text: By selecting phase-aligned patterns, SOHMs may explain how seemingly definite experiences come from probabilistic world models rather than a Bayesian blur of possibilities. Brains may keep full distributions in play in some phases of cognitive cycles and settle on discrete estimates in others.

sources.quote: The ability of SOHMs to select aligned patterns may help explain how seemingly definite experiences could emerge from probabilistic world models
Alternating workspace modes—potentially reflected by the formation/dissolution of mesoscale connectomic modularity
